name: Strategy Arbitration

method.strategy: Recursive ACT45 discovery followed by evidence-preserving arbitration

learning_from_previous_versions.v1: Do not fabricate missing metrics or use arbitrary defaults.
learning_from_previous_versions.v2: Do not assume candidate fields without verifying the ACT45 structure.
learning_from_previous_versions.v3: Verify that the previous cognitive layer has actually been parsed correctly.
learning_from_previous_versions.v4: The expected strategy fields may be nested. Field discovery must therefore be recursive.

arbitration.reason: ACT45 contains multiple explicit strategy candidates, but no candidate-specific metric is available for comparing at least two strategies. Qualitative states and global metrics were preserved without inventing numeric weights.

what_nox_learned: ACT46 V5 learned that cognitive-layer interoperability requires structural discovery before interpretation.
